examples.cn: 名字被刻在石碑上。

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · 拉丁 tabula
dict_mnemonic.text: tablet 来自拉丁语 tabula（木板、书写板），一块扁平之物，后来既指石碑，也指药片和能写画的平板电脑。

root: 拉丁语 tabula（木板、书写板）的指小形式 tabella，核心含义是「扁平的一片」。

sensesIntro.en: From a flat writing board come the stone slab, the pressed pill, and the touch screen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一块扁平书写板出发，长出了石碑、压制的药片与触摸屏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat board held in one hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：单手托着的一块扁平木板。

branches.en: A pill is a pressed disc.
branches.cn: 药片是压制成的小圆片。

branches.en: A slab carries carved names.
branches.cn: 石板承载雕刻的名字。

branches.en: A tablet is a glowing slate.
branches.cn: 平板电脑是会发光的石板。

branches.en: Both fit in the palm.
branches.cn: 两者都能握在掌心。

branches.en: Stone keeps memory for centuries.
branches.cn: 石头把记忆保存数百年。

intro.en: Tablet shares the tabula family with table and tabular.
intro.cn: tablet 与 table、tabular 同属 tabula 一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin tabula, board, gives English table, tablet, and tabular.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tabula（板）给英语留下 table、tablet、tabular。

items.example: The tablets are in the box.
The keys are on the table.
Pull the tab to open it.
The roof is made of slate.

definition_en: to explain the meaning of something, to understand it in a particular way, or to translate speech aloud
core_image: 两个人隔着一道模糊的玻璃，中间站着一个人把话从一边递到另一边
scene: 会议室里，译员戴着耳机，把发言人刚说完的一段话轻声转成另一种语言。 She had to interpret the silence as agreement.
sceneCN: 这里 interpret 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：给含义作出说明），句意为她只好把那阵沉默理解成同意。画面里的物件：耳机、话筒、会议记录。

pos.zh: 动词：解释；理解；口译；演绎

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「口译员；解释者」
由本词加 -ation 构成，义为「解释；理解」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 mis- 加本词构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: Work out the meaning
senses.definition: to explain or decide what something means, especially something unclear
senses.definitionCN: 解释或判定某事物的含义，尤指不清楚的东西
senses.example: There are several ways to interpret this clause.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款有好几种解释方式。
senses.why: Latin interpres was a go-between who explained one side to the other.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interpres 是在两边之间替人解释的中间人。

senses.title: Read in a certain way
senses.definition: to understand an action or event in one particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某一特定方式去理解某个动作或事件
senses.example: He interpreted her silence as refusal.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她沉默理解为拒绝。
senses.why: Once meaning is negotiable, the reader is the one who interprets.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义可以商量，做解释的就成了读者本人。

senses.title: Translate speech aloud
senses.definition: to translate spoken words from one language into another as they are said
senses.definitionCN: 在别人说话的同时把口头话语译成另一种语言
senses.example: She interpreted for the visiting minister all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个上午为来访的部长做口译。
senses.why: The old go-between sense survives most literally here: the go-between still stands between two tongues.
senses.whyCN: 古老的中间人义在这里保留得最直接：中间人仍站在两种语言之间。

senses.title: Perform a role
senses.definition: to perform a piece of music or drama in a way that shows one's own understanding
senses.definitionCN: 以体现个人理解的方式演奏乐曲或演绎戏剧
senses.example: The quartet interpreted the slow movement very freely.
senses.exampleCN: 四重奏把那个慢乐章演绎得很自由。
senses.why: Performance adds a final twist: the player becomes the go-between of the composer.
senses.whyCN: 表演又添了最后一转：演奏者成了作曲家的中间人。

intro.en: Interpret comes from Latin interpres, a negotiator or go-between who explains each side to the other.
intro.cn: interpret 来自拉丁语 interpres，指为两边互相解释的谈判者或中间人。

items.en: Interpres named the middleman who carried words between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递话语的中间人。

items.en: The verb interpretari meant to explain or negotiate.
items.cn: 动词 interpretari 意为「解释；谈判」。

items.en: Old French interpreter narrowed it towards explaining meaning.
items.cn: 古法语 interpreter 把它收窄到「解释含义」。

items.en: English used interpret for dreams, texts, and laws.
items.cn: 英语用 interpret 指解梦、解文、释法。

items.en: With live translation the word also took on the spoken sense.
items.cn: 随着现场翻译出现，这个词又添上口译义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the inter- prefix and its noun forms; the near-meaning group holds words about explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 前缀及其名词形式；近义组收表示「说明」的词。

entries.definition: The explanation or reading that results.
The person who translates speech aloud.
To break in on someone who is speaking.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「打断」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: To make something clear in plain words.
To put words of one language into another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「翻译」，书面与口头都可用。

entries.definition: To grasp what something means.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「理解」的内心动作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the go-between back at the centre of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「中间人」重新放回这个词的中心。

normal.en: inter- is between; an interpreter stands between two speakers.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」；口译员就站在两个说话人之间。

normal.en: To interpret a dream is to translate it into plain sense.
normal.cn: 解梦就是把它翻译成明白的道理。

normal.en: Interpret the look as a hint, and reading becomes a habit.
normal.cn: 把眼神也当成线索去读，阅读就成了习惯。

normal.en: The noun pile grows: interpreter, interpretation, interpretive.
normal.cn: 名词家族壮大：interpreter、interpretation、interpretive。

normal.en: Mis- at the front turns interpret into getting it wrong.
normal.cn: 前面加 mis- 就变成理解错了。

abstract.en: Interpretation is a bridge that only holds one passenger at a time.
abstract.cn: 解释是一座一次只能过一位行人的桥。

abstract.en: Every interpreter lends the speaker a borrowed voice.
abstract.cn: 每个译员都借给说话人一副嗓子。

abstract.en: Meaning does not travel; someone has to carry it.
abstract.cn: 意义不会自己走，总得有人去搬。

examples.en: Good readers interpret a poem before they judge it.
examples.cn: 好的读者先理解一首诗，再评判它。

examples.en: Nobody should interpret a shrug as a yes.
examples.cn: 谁都不该把一个耸肩当成同意。

examples.en: She learned to interpret between Chinese and Spanish.
examples.cn: 她学会了在中西两种语言之间做口译。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ pret（说清楚）——在两边之间把话说明白

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人、谈判者」→ interpretari「解释」→ 古法语 interpreter → 英语 interpret。同族有 interpreter、interpretation、misinterpret。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: explain a meaning, read something a certain way, translate speech live, and perform a work.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：阐明含义、按某种方式理解、现场口译，以及演绎作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing in the gap between two sides and carrying words across.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在两方之间的缝里，把话搬过对面。

branches.en: THE GLOSS: making an unclear meaning plain.
branches.cn: 注解这条线：把不清楚的含义讲清楚。

branches.en: THE LENS: every reader puts on a way of seeing.
branches.cn: 透镜这条线：每个读者都戴上一副看法。

branches.en: THE EARPIECE: words carried live across languages.
branches.cn: 耳机这条线：话语被当场搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE STAGE: the player speaks for the composer.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：演奏者替作曲家说话。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses make one meaning reach another person.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都让一种意思抵达另一个人。

intro.en: Interpret holds the prefix inter- "between" and an old Latin stem pret- of uncertain meaning.
intro.cn: interpret 含前缀 inter-「之间」与一个含义不确定的拉丁词干 pret-。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpres and interpretari are recorded; the inner stem is debated by scholars.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpres 与 interpretari 均有记载，其内部词干学者有争议。

items.example: It places the action between two parties.
items.exampleCN: 它把动作放在两方之间。

items.example: The stem is debated among etymologists.
items.exampleCN: 词源学者对这个词干有争论。

items.example: The noun is the oldest secure form.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是现存最古老可靠的形式。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.

definition_en: the written text of a film or play, a system of writing, a person's handwriting, or a set of computer instructions
core_image: 桌上摊开一份剧本，页边写满演员用铅笔做的批注
scene: 演员们在开拍前围读剧本。 The actors read the script together before filming.
sceneCN: 这里 script 是「剧本」（第 1 个义项）；句意：演员们在开拍前围读剧本。

senses.title: A text for a film or play
senses.definition: the written words and directions for a film, play, or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 电影、戏剧或广播的台词与说明文字
senses.example: The script needs another rewrite.
senses.exampleCN: 这个剧本还需要再改一稿。
senses.why: The central modern sense is the text actors follow.
senses.whyCN: 核心现代义是演员照读的文本。

senses.title: A system of writing
senses.definition: a set of written symbols used by a language
senses.definitionCN: 某种语言使用的一套书写符号
senses.example: These languages use different scripts.
senses.exampleCN: 这些语言使用不同的文字体系。
senses.why: Any written text is a script, so a whole writing system took the name.
senses.whyCN: 任何写下的文本都是 script，于是整套书写系统也用了这个词。

senses.title: A person's handwriting
senses.definition: the way a particular person writes by hand
senses.definitionCN: 某个人手写时的字体样式
senses.example: His script is small and neat.
senses.exampleCN: 他的笔迹小而工整。
senses.why: Handwriting is the most personal kind of written text.
senses.whyCN: 笔迹是最个人化的书写文本。

senses.title: Computer instructions
senses.definition: a set of instructions that a computer follows
senses.definitionCN: 计算机按顺序执行的一组指令
senses.example: The script runs every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这个脚本每天早上运行。
senses.why: A script is a text a machine reads and follows.
senses.whyCN: 脚本是机器阅读并执行的文本。

intro.en: Script comes from Latin scriptum, something written, from scribere, to write.
intro.cn: script 源自拉丁语 scriptum（写下的东西），来自 scribere（写）。

items.en: Scribere meant to write.
items.cn: scribere 意为写。

items.en: Scriptum meant something written.
items.cn: scriptum 意为写下的东西。

items.en: Script meant a written document.
items.cn: script 意为书面文件。

items.en: Script came to mean the text of a play.
items.cn: script 开始指戏剧文本。

items.en: Script also names writing systems and computer code.
items.cn: 现代英语中 script 还指书写体系与计算机代码。

note.en: Script is compared with similar-looking words and with words for written texts.
note.cn: 把 script 与形近词以及表示书面文本的词作比较。

a certificate or small paper
sacred writing
a script for a film
written words

normalIntro.en: Script is anything written, from a play to computer code.
normalIntro.cn: script 是任何写下来的东西，从剧本到计算机代码。

normal.en: Actors read a script.
normal.cn: 演员读剧本。

normal.en: Different languages use different scripts.
normal.cn: 不同语言使用不同文字体系。

normal.en: Neat script means neat handwriting.
normal.cn: neat script 意为工整的笔迹。

normal.en: A computer script runs instructions.
normal.cn: 计算机脚本执行指令。

normal.en: A scriptwriter writes scripts.
normal.cn: scriptwriter 写剧本。

abstract.en: Writing turns speech into something that can be followed.
abstract.cn: 书写把言语变成可以照做的事。

abstract.en: A play, a writing system, and code are all texts to be read.
abstract.cn: 戏剧、文字体系与代码都是供阅读的文本。

abstract.en: Script links human writing with machine reading.
abstract.cn: script 把人类书写与机器读取连接起来。

examples.en: The script needs another rewrite.
examples.cn: 这个剧本还需要再改一稿。

examples.en: These languages use different scripts.
examples.cn: 这些语言使用不同的文字体系。

examples.en: The script runs every morning.
examples.cn: 这个脚本每天早上运行。

dict_mnemonic.text: script 源自拉丁语 scribere（写），script 就是「写下来的东西」，所以既指文字、笔迹，也指剧本和脚本。

root: 源自拉丁语 scriptum（写下的东西），来自 scribere（写），核心义「书写下来的文本」。

sensesIntro.en: Script means a film or play text, a writing system, handwriting, or computer instructions.
sensesIntro.cn: script 意为影视剧本、文字体系、笔迹，或计算机脚本。

definition_en: a place where something happens, a part of a play or film, or a view
core_image: 警戒线围起的街角，警灯闪烁，路人远远围观
scene: 事故现场很快被警戒线围住。 Police soon arrived at the scene of the accident.
sceneCN: 这里 scene 是「现场」（第 2 个义项）；句意：警察很快赶到事故现场。

senses.title: Part of a story
senses.definition: a part of a play, film, or book in which events happen in one place
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧、电影或书中在同一个地点发生事件的一段
senses.example: The opening scene takes place in a kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 开场场景发生在一间厨房里。
senses.why: The core sense is a staged unit of action.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一个被呈现的动作单元。

senses.title: Place of an event
senses.definition: the place where something, especially an accident or crime, happened
senses.definitionCN: 某事尤其事故或犯罪发生的地点
senses.example: Reporters rushed to the scene.
senses.exampleCN: 记者们赶到现场。
senses.why: The stage becomes the real place of action.
senses.whyCN: 舞台变成真实事件发生的地点。

senses.title: View of a place
senses.definition: a view of a place, especially a beautiful one
senses.definitionCN: 某地的景象，尤指美丽的景色
senses.example: The mountain scene was painted in soft colours.
senses.exampleCN: 山景被用柔和的色彩画了出来。
senses.why: A framed view resembles a stage set.
senses.whyCN: 被框住的景象就像舞台布景。

senses.title: Public outburst
senses.definition: a noisy or angry display in front of others
senses.definitionCN: 在他人面前吵闹或发怒的表现
senses.example: Please do not make a scene in the restaurant.
senses.exampleCN: 请不要在餐厅里当众吵闹。
senses.why: A public display is like a drama performed for others.
senses.whyCN: 当众表现就像为他人上演的戏剧。

senses.title: Social world
senses.definition: a particular area of activity or group of people
senses.definitionCN: 特定的活动领域或人群圈子
senses.example: She knows everyone in the music scene.
senses.exampleCN: 她认识音乐圈里的所有人。
senses.why: A social world is a stage with its own players.
senses.whyCN: 社交世界就是有自己演员的舞台。

intro.cn: scene 经拉丁语 scaena 源自希腊语 skene（帐篷、舞台建筑）。

items.en: Skene meant a tent or the stage building.
items.cn: skene 意为帐篷或舞台建筑。

items.en: Scaena named the stage and what appears on it.
items.cn: scaena 指舞台及舞台上的呈现。

items.en: Scene named a division of a play.
items.cn: scene 指戏剧的一个段落。

items.en: Scene entered English as a stage unit.
items.cn: scene 以舞台单元之义进入英语。

items.en: Scene extends to real places, views, and social worlds.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scene 扩展到真实地点、景色与社交圈。

note.en: Scene is compared with similar spellings and with words for setting and spectacle.
note.cn: 把 scene 与形近词以及表示场景和景象的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Scene began as the stage building and spread to every kind of setting.
normalIntro.cn: scene 起初指舞台建筑，后来扩展到各种场景。

normal.en: A scene is a picture with action inside it.
normal.cn: 场景就是一幅包含动作的画面。

normal.en: The scene of the crime is the place detectives study.
normal.cn: 犯罪现场是侦探研究的地点。

normal.en: Behind the scenes means out of public view.
normal.cn: behind the scenes 意为在公众视野之外。

normal.en: Make a scene means act out anger in public.
normal.cn: make a scene 意为当众发怒。

normal.en: The music scene is the world of musicians and fans.
normal.cn: 音乐圈就是音乐人和歌迷的世界。

abstract.en: Life is made of scenes, and memory keeps only some.
abstract.cn: 生活由一个个场景组成，记忆只留下其中一些。

abstract.en: Every public scene has an audience.
abstract.cn: 每一个公开场面都有观众。

abstract.en: A stage and a crime site share the same word.
abstract.cn: 舞台与犯罪现场共用一个词。

examples.en: The final scene of the film was silent.
examples.cn: 电影的最后一场是无声的。

examples.en: Photographers gathered at the scene.
examples.cn: 摄影师们聚集在现场。

examples.en: He made a scene when the order was wrong.
examples.cn: 订单出错时他当众发作了。

sensesIntro.en: Scene means a unit of a story, the place of an event, a view, a public outburst, or a social world.
sensesIntro.cn: scene 意为故事场景、事件现场、景色、当众发作，或某个社交圈。

core.en: A stage-like place or unit where action happens.
core.cn: 像舞台一样承载动作的场所或单元。

branches.en: A staged unit of a play or film.
branches.cn: 戏剧或电影中的一段场景。

branches.en: The real place where an event happened.
branches.cn: 事件发生的真实地点。

branches.en: A view framed like a stage set.
branches.cn: 像舞台布景一样被框住的景色。

items.example: The scene is set at night.
The scenic road follows the coast.

舞台设计师搭建了布景。

items.example: Much work happens behind the scenes.
The crime scene was sealed off.

definition_zh: 风景；景观；地貌；（某一领域的）局面；（印刷、摄影）横向版式
definition_en: the visible features of an area of land; a picture representing such scenery; the overall pattern of a field of activity; (printing) a page format wider than it is tall
core_image: 从高处望下去，田野、河流与道路拼成一整幅画
scene: 地理课上，老师把投影切成一幅航拍图。 The valley landscape was left behind by a retreating glacier.
sceneCN: 这里 landscape 是「地貌景观」（第 1 个义项：一片土地的可见形态）；句意：这条河谷景观是冰川退却后留下的。

pos.zh: 风景；景观；地貌（可数指一片景观，不可数指景观类型）
（某领域的）局面；横向版式（常带修饰语，如 political landscape）

senses.title: Visible features of land
senses.definition: the shape, texture, and features of an area of land, including hills, rivers, fields, and vegetation
senses.definitionCN: 一片土地的形状、质地与特征，包括山丘、河流、田野与植被
senses.example: Glaciers shaped the landscape of this valley.
senses.exampleCN: 冰川塑造了这条河谷的地貌。
senses.why: Landscape is borrowed from Dutch landschap, land plus -schap, a suffix of state or condition cognate with English -ship. The word began as 'the condition of the land', which is why it can name both a region and how that region looks.
senses.whyCN: landscape 借自荷兰语 landschap，由 land 加 -schap 构成，后者是表示状态或状况的后缀，与英语 -ship 同源。这个词最初意为“土地的状况”，所以它既能命名一片区域，也能命名这片区域的样子。

senses.title: A landscape painting
senses.definition: a painting or photograph whose main subject is natural scenery
senses.definitionCN: 以自然景色为主要题材的绘画或摄影
senses.example: The museum bought a seventeenth-century Dutch landscape.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆买下一幅 17 世纪荷兰风景画。
senses.why: The word entered English in the sixteenth century as an art term: a picture of a land. Dutch painters made the genre famous, and the word travelled with the paintings.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在 16 世纪作为艺术术语进入英语：一幅关于土地的画。荷兰画家使这一画种闻名，词随画一起传来。

senses.title: Landscape in geography and ecology
senses.titleCN: 地理与生态学中的景观
senses.definition: an area considered as a system of interacting physical, biological, and human features
senses.definitionCN: 被视作物理、生物与人文特征交互系统的区域
senses.example: Landscape ecology studies how patches of habitat connect.
senses.exampleCN: 景观生态学研究栖息地斑块如何连接。
senses.why: Geography turned the word into a technical unit: a landscape is not just a view but a system with boundaries and flows. The visual sense survives inside the scientific one.
senses.whyCN: 地理学把这个词变成技术单位：景观不只是视野，而是有边界与流动的系统。视觉义在科学义内部存活下来。

senses.title: The pattern of a field of activity
senses.definition: the overall arrangement of forces, players, or conditions in a particular area of activity
senses.definitionCN: 某一活动领域中力量、参与者或条件的总体布局
senses.example: The merger changed the competitive landscape of the industry.
senses.exampleCN: 这次合并改变了该行业的竞争格局。
senses.why: Twentieth-century business and political writing borrowed the word for a field of play: competitors occupy positions the way hills occupy a view. The metaphor is spatial, and it treats the situation as something seen from above.
senses.whyCN: 20 世纪的商业与政治写作把这个词借来指一个竞技场：竞争者占据位置，就像山丘占据视野。这个比喻是空间性的，把局势当作从高处看到的东西。

senses.title: Landscape page format
senses.definition: a page or image orientation in which the width is greater than the height
senses.definitionCN: 宽度大于高度的页面或图像方向
senses.example: Print the map in landscape format so the whole route fits.
senses.exampleCN: 把地图打成横向版式，好让整条路线容纳进来。
senses.why: Printing and photography borrowed the word because a wide page resembles a landscape view: the eye moves sideways across it. The term now means orientation alone, with no scenery involved.
senses.whyCN: 印刷与摄影借用这个词，因为宽页面像一幅风景视野：视线横向扫过。这个术语如今只指方向，与景色无关。

senses.title: Landscape design
senses.definition: the planned shaping of gardens, parks, and grounds for use and appearance
senses.definitionCN: 为使用与外观而对花园、公园与场地进行的规划性塑造
senses.example: The landscape of the campus was redesigned last year.
senses.exampleCN: 校园的景观去年被重新设计。
senses.why: Gardening adopted the word in the eighteenth century, when improvers began shaping views rather than merely planting. Landscape became both the object seen and the act of arranging it.
senses.whyCN: 园艺在 18 世纪采用这个词，当时造园者开始塑造视野，而不只是种植。landscape 由此既指被看见的对象，也指安排它的行为。

senses.title: Cultural landscape
senses.definition: a landscape shaped by human activity and carrying the marks of a community's history
senses.definitionCN: 由人类活动塑造、带有群体历史印记的景观
senses.example: Rice terraces are a cultural landscape maintained for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 梯田是维护了数百年的文化景观。
senses.why: Heritage studies use the term to reject the split between nature and culture: a landscape is co-produced by people and place. The word then carries a claim about who made what we see.
senses.whyCN: 遗产研究用这个术语来否定自然与文化的截然二分：景观由人与地方共同生产。这个词由此承载一个主张：我们所见的景象是谁造成的。

senses.title: The current overall situation
senses.definition: the general state of affairs that someone surveys before acting
senses.definitionCN: 某人在行动前所审视的总体状况
senses.example: Before launching the product, they studied the regulatory landscape.
senses.exampleCN: 在推出产品之前，他们研究了监管形势。
senses.why: This sense generalises the spatial metaphor to any field: the landscape is what you see when you step back. It implies a survey before a decision, not a detailed analysis of one part.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把空间比喻推广到任何领域：景观是你退后一步看到的东西。它暗示决策前的总体巡视，而不是对某一局部的细致分析。

intro.en: Landscape is a sixteenth-century borrowing from Dutch landschap, land plus -schap (state, condition), cognate with English -ship. It entered English first as a painting term and later spread to geography, gardening, and figurative usage.
intro.cn: landscape 是 16 世纪从荷兰语 landschap 借来的词，由 land 加 -schap（状态、状况）构成，与英语 -ship 同源。它先作为绘画术语进入英语，后来扩展到地理、园艺与比喻用法。

items.en: Dutch landschap combined land with -schap, a suffix of condition or collection, related to English -ship. The word meant 'the condition of the land' or 'a region', not yet a picture.
items.cn: 荷兰语 landschap 把 land 与表示状况或集合的后缀 -schap 结合，后者与英语 -ship 相关。该词意为“土地的状况”或“一片地区”，当时还不是画。

items.en: English borrowed landscape in the sixteenth century as a term for a painting of scenery, alongside the older variant landskip. The artistic sense came first in English usage.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入 landscape，作为描绘景色的绘画术语，同时还有较早的变体 landskip。在英语用法中，艺术义最先出现。

items.en: Landscape gardening made the word active: to landscape a park was to arrange its views. The noun and the verb then grew together.
items.cn: 景观造园使这个词变为主动：landscape a park 意为安排它的视野。名词与动词由此一起生长。

items.en: Geography adopted landscape as a technical term for the visible form of a region, studied through maps and fieldwork. Physical and cultural landscapes were distinguished.
items.cn: 地理学采用 landscape 作为区域可见形态的技术术语，通过地图与野外工作研究。自然景观与文化景观被区分开来。

items.en: Business, politics, and journalism extended the word to any field of activity, producing phrases such as 'the competitive landscape'. The spatial metaphor became a standard way to describe strategy.
items.cn: 商业、政治与新闻把这个词扩展到任何活动领域，产生 the competitive landscape 等说法。空间比喻成为描述战略的标准方式。

items.en: Printing and photography borrowed landscape for a page wider than it is tall, because such a page resembles a wide view. The term now names orientation alone.
items.cn: 印刷与摄影借用 landscape 指宽大于高的页面，因为这样的页面像一幅宽视野。这个术语如今只命名方向。

note.en: The look-alike group separates words sharing the -scape suffix or the land element but built on different bases; the near-meaning group separates scenery, terrain, and view.
note.cn: 形近组区分共享 -scape 后缀或 land 成分但基词不同的词；近义组区分 scenery、terrain 与 view。

entries.definition: a view or picture of the sea. It is a modern formation on the model of landscape, replacing land with sea.
entries.definitionCN: 海景或海景画。它是仿 landscape 构成的现代词，把 land 换成 sea。

entries.definition: someone blamed for others' faults. The scape here comes from escape, not from landscape's -schap; the resemblance is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 替他人受责的人。这里的 scape 来自 escape，而非 landscape 的 -schap；相似纯属偶然。

entries.definition: the sliding down of earth or rock, or an overwhelming election victory. It joins land with slide, with no sense of scenery.
entries.definitionCN: 土石滑落，或压倒性的选举胜利。它把 land 与 slide 结合，与景色无关。

entries.definition: the general appearance of a place, especially when attractive. It is uncountable and evaluative; landscape can be neutral and countable.
entries.definitionCN: 一个地方的整体外观，尤指宜人时。它不可数且带评价；landscape 可中性、可数。

entries.definition: the physical surface of land, especially as it affects movement. It stresses ground conditions, while landscape includes what is seen.
entries.definitionCN: 土地的物理表面，尤指影响行进时。它强调地面条件，而 landscape 包含所见之物。

entries.definition: what can be seen from a particular place. It depends on the observer's position; a landscape exists as a region, whether or not anyone is looking.
entries.definitionCN: 从某一地点能看到的东西。它取决于观察者的位置；landscape 作为区域存在，无论是否有人在看。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: Dutch landschap, the -ship suffix, the painting term of the sixteenth century, and the modern phrase political landscape.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：荷兰语 landschap、-ship 后缀、16 世纪的绘画术语，以及现代说法 political landscape。

normal.en: land + -schap (the same suffix as -ship): landscape is 'the condition of the land'.
normal.cn: land + -schap（与 -ship 同源的后缀）：landscape 就是“土地的状况”。

normal.en: It entered English as a painting word, which is why a landscape can be a picture as well as a place.
normal.cn: 它作为绘画词进入英语，所以 landscape 既可是地方，也可是画。

normal.en: A wide page is printed in landscape because it looks like a wide view.
normal.cn: 宽页面以横向打印，因为它看起来像一幅宽视野。

normal.en: 'Political landscape' treats parties as hills occupying positions in a view.
normal.cn: political landscape 把政党当作占据视野中位置的山丘。

normal.en: seascape and cityscape are modern copies of the same pattern.
normal.cn: seascape 与 cityscape 是同一模式的现代仿造词。

abstract.en: The suffix means condition, not picture: the word is about how land stands, and the picture is a later use.
abstract.cn: 后缀意为状况，而非图画：这个词关乎土地处于何种状态，图画是后来的用法。

abstract.en: Every figurative landscape invites you to step back — the word always implies a viewing distance.
abstract.cn: 每一个比喻性的 landscape 都邀请你退后一步——这个词总暗示一段观看距离。

abstract.en: A cultural landscape denies the split between nature and human history: what you see was co-produced.
abstract.cn: 文化景观否定自然与人类历史的二分：你所见的是共同生产的。

examples.en: The volcanic landscape attracts hikers from around the world.
examples.cn: 这片火山地貌吸引着世界各地的徒步者。

examples.en: The election reshaped the political landscape of the country.
examples.cn: 这次选举重塑了该国的政治格局。

examples.en: The map is printed in landscape so that the coastline fits on one page.
examples.cn: 地图以横向版式印制，好让海岸线容纳在一页内。

dict_mnemonic.text: “兰德斯给普”——荷兰的兰德斯（Land）把土地的样子“给”了出来 → landscape 风景、景观

root: 荷兰语 landschap = land（土地）+ -schap（状态、状况，与英语 -ship 同源）；字面义“土地的状况”，核心是“从远处看到的一片土地的形态与格局”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of landscape all describe a wide arrangement seen as a whole: terrain, a painting, an ecological system, a field of competition, a page, a designed garden, a human-shaped heritage, and the current situation. The word always implies a viewing distance.
sensesIntro.cn: landscape 的八个义项都描述被当作整体看待的宽广布局：地貌、绘画、生态系统、竞争场域、页面、设计的园林、人塑造的遗产，以及当前形势。这个词总暗示一段观看距离。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a high vantage point where fields, a river, and roads compose one picture.
core.cn: 核心意象：一处高处的视点，田野、河流与道路组成一幅画。

branches.en: NATURE: terrain and ecological systems are landscapes as regions, not merely as views.
branches.cn: 自然：地貌与生态系统作为区域性的景观，而不只是视野。

branches.en: ART AND DESIGN: painting and garden-making both arrange what will be seen.
branches.cn: 艺术与设计：绘画与造园都在安排将被看到的东西。

branches.en: SITUATION: fields of activity are surveyed from above and described as layouts.
branches.cn: 形势：活动领域被从高处巡视，并被描述为布局。

branches.en: FORMAT: a wide page borrows the shape of a wide view.
branches.cn: 版式：宽页面借用了宽视野的形状。

branches.en: HERITAGE: a cultural landscape denies the split between nature and human history.
branches.cn: 遗产：文化景观否定自然与人类历史的二分。

intro.en: Landscape is Dutch landschap, land + -schap, cognate with English -ship. The suffix has become productive in English: seascape, cityscape, and moonscape are modern coinages on the same pattern.
intro.cn: landscape 是荷兰语 landschap，由 land + -schap 构成，与英语 -ship 同源。这个后缀在英语中变得能产：seascape、cityscape、moonscape 都是按同一模式造的现代词。

latinIntro.en: Landscape has no Latin root: it is a Germanic compound of land and -schap. The nearest Latin relatives in English vocabulary are terra 'land' and campus 'field', which supply terrain and campus, but they are not etymological relatives.
latinIntro.cn: landscape 没有拉丁词根：它是 land 与 -schap 的日耳曼语复合词。英语词汇中最近的拉丁亲属是 terra“土地”与 campus“田野”，它们提供 terrain 与 campus，但并非词源亲属。

items.meaning: the visible form of a region; a picture of it
items.example: The landscape changed after the flood.

items.meaningCN: 经景观设计的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.exampleCN: 酒店有经过设计的园林。

items.meaningCN: 景观布置；造景（-ing 构成名词）
items.exampleCN: 景观布置提升了房产价值。

items.meaningCN: 景观设计师；园林工（-er 表施动者）
items.exampleCN: 景观设计师种下本地草类。

items.meaning: a view or picture of the sea
the visual character of a city
items.example: The cityscape is dominated by glass towers.
items.exampleCN: 城市景观以玻璃塔楼为主。

items.meaningCN: 月球表面景观；荒凉地貌（moon + -scape）
items.example: The mining site resembled a moonscape.
items.exampleCN: 矿区看起来像月球表面。

items.meaning: the solid surface of the earth
items.meaningCN: 土地；陆地（古英语本族词）
items.example: The land rises toward the hills.

items.meaningCN: 风景画（古旧变体，今已罕用）
items.exampleCN: 清单上列有两幅风景画。

definition_en: the underground part of a plant, the origin of something, or the base of a word
core_image: 盘在泥土里的树根
scene: 这棵老树的根深深扎进岩石缝里。 The roots of the old tree reach deep into the rock.
sceneCN: 这里 root 是「植物的根」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这棵老树的根深深扎进岩石缝里。

senses.title: Plant root
senses.definition: the part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water
senses.definitionCN: 植物在地下生长并吸收水分的部分
senses.example: The tree has roots near the water pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵树的根靠近水管。
senses.why: The plant is held and fed from below.
senses.whyCN: 植物从下方被固定并获取养分。

senses.title: Origin
senses.definition: the basic cause or origin of a problem or situation
senses.definitionCN: 问题或状况的根本原因与来源
senses.example: Money lies at the root of the quarrel.
senses.exampleCN: 金钱是这场争吵的根源。
senses.why: The hidden cause is like a root underground.
senses.whyCN: 隐藏的原因就像地下的根。

senses.title: Word base
senses.definition: the basic part of a word that carries its main meaning
senses.definitionCN: 承载单词主要意义的基本部分
senses.example: The root port means to carry.
senses.exampleCN: 词根 port 意为搬运。
senses.why: Other words grow from this base like branches.
senses.whyCN: 其他词像枝条一样从这个基础长出来。

senses.title: Take hold
senses.definition: to grow roots, or to become firmly established
senses.definitionCN: 长出根，或牢固地确立下来
senses.example: The custom rooted itself in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这个习俗在村子里扎下了根。
senses.why: The verb makes the plant image into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词把植物意象变成一种行为。

intro.en: Root comes from Old English rot, related to Latin radix.
intro.cn: root 源自古代英语 rot，与拉丁语 radix 相关。

items.en: Radix means root and gives radical.
items.cn: radix 意为根，并给出 radical。

items.en: Rot names the root of a plant.
items.cn: rot 指植物的根。

items.en: Rot keeps the same underground sense.
items.cn: rot 保留同样的地下根部含义。

items.en: Root extends to the cause of a problem.
items.cn: root 扩展到问题的起因。

items.en: Root also names the base of a word.
items.cn: root 又指单词的词根。

note.en: A root feeds a plant; a route is a way to go.
note.cn: root 为植物供给养分，route 则是行走的路线。

entries.definition: a way from one place to another
learning by repetition
firmly fixed
the place something comes from
the beginning of something
the bottom or founding part

normalIntro.en: A root holds the plant and hides the origin.
normalIntro.cn: root 固定植物，也隐藏着事物的起源。

normal.en: The roots spread under the whole garden.
normal.cn: 树根蔓延到整个花园地下。

normal.en: We must find the root cause of the delay.
normal.cn: 我们必须找到延误的根本原因。

normal.en: The root of the word means light.
normal.cn: 这个词的词根意为光。

normal.en: The habit took root in a single summer.
normal.cn: 这个习惯在一个夏天里扎了根。

normal.en: They rooted out the old rules.
normal.cn: 他们铲除了旧规则。

abstract.en: Picture roots gripping soil under a tall tree.
abstract.cn: 想象高树之下紧紧抓住泥土的根。

abstract.en: Imagine a hidden spring feeding a river.
abstract.cn: 想象一眼隐藏的泉滋养着河流。

abstract.en: Think of a word family growing from one base.
abstract.cn: 想象一个词族从一个基础生长出来。

examples.en: The storm pulled the tree out by its roots.
examples.cn: 暴风雨把树连根拔起。

examples.en: Fear is often the root of such anger.
examples.cn: 恐惧常常是这种愤怒的根源。

examples.en: The word has a Latin root.
examples.cn: 这个词有一个拉丁词根。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「root」像「如土」——像土里藏着的那部分，就是根；藏起来的源头，就是根源。

root: 古代英语 rot（根）与拉丁语 radix（根）同源，核心义「藏在下方、支撑整体的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Root means a plant's underground part, an origin, a word base, or to become established.
sensesIntro.cn: root 意为植物的根、事物的根源、词根，或扎根确立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: roots gripping soil underground.
core.cn: 核心意象：泥土中盘结的树根。

branches.en: The plant part is the first sense.
branches.cn: 植物的根是第一个义项。

branches.en: The hidden cause is the second.
branches.cn: 隐藏的起因是第二个义项。

branches.en: The word base is the third.
branches.cn: 词根是第三个义项。

branches.en: The verb makes the plant take hold.
branches.cn: 动词让植物扎根。

branches.en: All senses share one hidden base.
branches.cn: 所有义项共享一个隐藏的基础。

intro.en: Root has an Old English body and a Latin cousin, radix.
intro.cn: root 有古代英语的主体，也有拉丁语表亲 radix。

latinIntro.en: Latin radix gives radical; English root stays Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 radix 给出 radical；英语 root 保持日耳曼来源。

rooted 加上了形容词词尾。
deep-rooted 由 deep 与 rooted 组合。

definition_zh: 知觉；感知；看法；观念；洞察力；感知能力；印象；公众认知；机器感知
definition_en: the act or result of becoming aware of something through the senses or the mind, the view a person or public holds, keen insight, or the process by which a system interprets input
core_image: 眼睛和耳朵把外面的世界收进一张内部地图，再给上面的每样东西写上名字
scene: 同一场雨，有人只听见噪音，有人听出雨势在变小。 Two people hear the same rain differently, and the difference lies in perception.
sceneCN: 这里 perception 是「感知能力」（第 4 个义项：感官对细微差别作出分辨的能力）；句意：两个人听同一场雨听到的不一样，差别就在感知能力；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 知觉；感知；看法；观念；洞察力；印象

derivatives.zh: 有洞察力的；感知敏锐的

senses.title: Awareness through the senses
senses.definition: the act or result of becoming aware of objects and events through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell
senses.definitionCN: 通过视觉、听觉、触觉、味觉或嗅觉觉察物体与事件的行为或结果
senses.example: Perception of the low hum came before any conscious thought.
senses.exampleCN: 对那阵低鸣的知觉出现在任何有意识的想法之前。
senses.why: Percipere is per- 'thoroughly' plus capere 'to take': the senses take the world in and hold it. Perception is that grasping, the moment the outer world becomes an inner object.
senses.whyCN: percipere 是 per-“彻底”加 capere“拿取”：感官把世界拿进来并握住。perception 就是这一抓，是外部世界变成内部对象的那一刻。

senses.title: The grasp the mind forms
senses.definition: the mental understanding or interpretation a person forms about a situation, often beyond bare sensory data
senses.definitionCN: 一个人对某种情况形成的理解或解释，常超出纯粹的感官材料
senses.example: Her perception of the risk was sharper than the numbers suggested.
senses.exampleCN: 她对风险的判断比数字显示的更敏锐。
senses.why: The hand that takes can also sort and name. Once the inner map is drawn, perception means not only seeing the shape but understanding what it is.
senses.whyCN: 拿取的那只手也会分类和命名。内部地图画好之后，perception 不仅指看见形状，还指明白它是什么。

senses.title: The view people hold
senses.definition: the opinion, image, or belief that a person or the public holds about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 某个人或公众对某人某事持有的看法、形象或信念
senses.example: Public perception of the agency improved after the open day.
senses.exampleCN: 开放日之后，公众对该机构的看法有所改善。
senses.why: Many inner maps can agree. When they do, perception becomes a social fact: not what is out there, but what a group has taken in and agreed to see.
senses.whyCN: 许多内部地图可以彼此一致。一旦一致，perception 就成了社会事实：不是外面有什么，而是一个群体拿进来并同意看见什么。

senses.title: Keenness of sensing
senses.definition: the acuity or fineness of a person's or animal's senses in detecting small differences
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物的感官在察觉细微差别时的敏锐程度
senses.example: A dog's perception of scent far exceeds a human's.
senses.exampleCN: 狗对气味的感知能力远远超过人。
senses.why: The same hand can be strong or weak. This sense speaks of the instrument rather than the object: a fine net takes more of the sea than a coarse one.
senses.whyCN: 同一只手可以有力或无力。这个义项说的是工具本身而不是对象：细网比粗网能从海里捞起更多东西。

senses.title: Insight into what is hidden
senses.definition: the ability to notice and understand things that are not obvious to others, especially motives or patterns
senses.definitionCN: 察觉并理解他人不易看到之事的能力，尤指动机或规律
senses.example: With unusual perception, she named the fear behind his joke.
senses.exampleCN: 她以不寻常的洞察力，说出了他玩笑背后的恐惧。
senses.why: Perception can go through the surface to the structure beneath it. The eye does not just receive; it reads the map for what the map is hiding.
senses.whyCN: 感知可以穿过表层看到下面的结构。眼睛不只是接收，它还读地图，读出地图藏起来的东西。

senses.title: The field that studies sensing
senses.definition: the branch of psychology and neuroscience that studies how organisms organize and interpret sensory information
senses.definitionCN: 心理学与神经科学中研究生物如何组织并解释感官信息的分支
senses.example: The paper reviews fifty years of research on visual perception.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文回顾了视觉知觉五十年的研究。
senses.why: When the act becomes a subject, perception turns into a field with methods and experiments. The word no longer names one grasping but the laws of grasping in general.
senses.whyCN: 当这个行为成为研究对象时，perception 变成一门有方法与实验的学科。这个词不再命名某一次抓取，而是抓取的一般规律。

senses.title: What is sensed versus what is real
senses.titleCN: 所感与所实之间的距离
senses.definition: in philosophy, the relation between sensory appearance and the object or reality that is believed to cause it
senses.definitionCN: 哲学中感官显现与被认为是其成因的对象或实在之间的关系
senses.example: The argument turns on whether perception gives us the object itself.
senses.exampleCN: 这一论证的关键在于：知觉是否把对象本身给了我们。
senses.why: The inner map may not match the land. Philosophy uses perception for the whole problem of whether the copy in the mind is faithful to what lies outside it.
senses.whyCN: 内部地图未必与真实地形相符。哲学用 perception 指整个问题：心里的副本是否忠实地对应外面的东西。

senses.title: The impression others receive
senses.definition: the impression a person or organization creates in others, especially through appearance, tone, and manner
senses.definitionCN: 一个人或组织在他人心中造成的印象，尤指通过外表、语气与举止
senses.example: His calm voice shaped the jury's perception of him as honest.
senses.exampleCN: 他平静的声音让陪审团觉得他是个诚实的人。
senses.why: Here the map is drawn in another person's head. Perception is the image you did not write but caused, and it can diverge sharply from what you intended.
senses.whyCN: 这里的地图画在别人的头脑里。perception 是你没有亲手写、却由你造成的形象，它可以与你原本的意图相差很远。

senses.title: A machine interpreting input
senses.definition: the process by which a computer system detects, classifies, and interprets signals from cameras, microphones, or other sensors
senses.definitionCN: 计算机系统检测、分类并解释来自摄像头、麦克风或其他传感器的信号的过程
senses.example: Machine perception lets the car read the road markings.
senses.exampleCN: 机器感知让汽车能读懂路面标线。
senses.why: Engineers build the same loop with silicon: a sensor takes in, a model names. The word keeps its shape even when the eye is a camera and the mind is an algorithm.
senses.whyCN: 工程师用硅片搭出同样的回路：传感器拿进来，模型来命名。即使眼睛变成摄像头、头脑变成算法，这个词的形状也没有变。

intro.en: Perception comes from Latin perceptio, an action noun from percipere 'to take in, grasp, perceive'. Percipere is per- 'thoroughly' plus capere 'to take, seize'. English borrowed perception in the 14th century first for the taking in of knowledge or the receiving of impressions, and the modern sensory sense settled in the 19th century with the rise of experimental psychology.
intro.cn: perception 来自拉丁语 perceptio，是 percipere“拿进来、把握、感知”的动作名词。percipere 由 per-“彻底”加 capere“拿取、抓取”构成。英语在 14 世纪借入 perception，最初指“接受知识或接收印象”，现代感官义则在 19 世纪随着实验心理学兴起而定型。

items.en: Capere means 'to take, seize, capture'. With per- 'through, thoroughly', percipere means 'to take hold of completely', and by extension 'to grasp with the mind'.
items.cn: capere 意为“拿取、抓取、俘获”。加上 per-“穿过、彻底”，percipere 意为“完全抓住”，引申为“用头脑把握”。

items.en: Perceptio in Latin covers receiving, collecting, and comprehension. The word already lives on the border between the senses and the mind.
items.cn: 拉丁语 perceptio 同时涵盖接收、收集与理解。这个词从一开始就住在感官与心智的边界上。

items.en: English perception first means the receiving of impressions or the act of understanding, especially in religious and legal prose.
items.cn: 英语 perception 最早指接收印象或理解的行为，尤见于宗教与法律文字。

items.en: Philosophy makes perception a central term in the debate over what the mind directly knows: ideas, impressions, or external objects.
items.cn: 哲学使 perception 成为争论的核心术语，争论的问题是心智直接知道什么：观念、印象，还是外部对象。

items.en: Experimental psychology separates sensation from perception: sensation is raw input, perception is the organized interpretation of it.
items.cn: 实验心理学把感觉与知觉分开：感觉是原始输入，知觉是对它的有组织解释。

items.en: The word extends to social perception in politics and to machine perception in computing, keeping the same loop of taking in and naming.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到政治中的社会认知与计算中的机器感知，保留着同一个“拿进来再命名”的回路。

note.en: The first group separates the percept family from two words that look close but have different roots. The second group compares sensation, cognition, view, and insight, the four words most often put in perception's place.
note.cn: 第一组把 percept 词族与两个形近但词根不同的词分开。第二组比较感觉、认知、看法与洞察力，这四个词最常被用来替代 perception。

entries.definition: the object or content of a perception, the thing as sensed rather than as thought. Perception names the act, percept names what is taken in.
entries.definitionCN: 知觉的对象或内容，即被感觉到而非被思考的东西。perception 命名行为，percept 命名被拿进来的东西。

entries.definition: quick to notice and understand things. It describes a person's ability, while perception can name the act, the view, or the field of study.
entries.definitionCN: 善于察觉与理解的。它描述人的能力，而 perception 可以命名行为、看法或学科。

entries.definition: a point of view or the art of drawing depth. Its root is specere 'to look', not capere 'to take', so it names where you look from, not what you take in.
entries.definitionCN: 观点，或描绘深度的技法。它的词根是 specere“看”，不是 capere“拿取”，所以它命名的是你从哪里看，而不是你拿进了什么。

entries.definition: a rate per hundred. Its per- is the same, but the root is centum 'hundred', so it has nothing to do with taking or sensing.
entries.definitionCN: 以百为基数的比率。它的 per- 相同，但词根是 centum“一百”，与拿取或感知毫无关系。

entries.definition: a feeling or impression produced by stimulation of a sense organ. It is the raw input that perception organizes and interprets.
entries.definitionCN: 感觉器官受刺激产生的感受或印象。它是知觉加以组织与解释的原始输入。

entries.definition: the mental processes of knowing, remembering, and reasoning. It is the wider mental side, of which perception is the entry stage.
entries.definitionCN: 知道、记忆与推理的心理过程。它是更宽的心智面，而知觉是其中的入口阶段。

entries.definition: an opinion held and usually expressed. It is the social sense of perception made explicit and arguable.
entries.definitionCN: 持有并通常会表达的意见。它是 perception 社会义的外显、可争论版本。

entries.definition: a deep and accurate understanding of something hidden or complex. It is the sharpest end of perception, where the map reveals its own structure.
entries.definitionCN: 对隐藏或复杂事物的深刻而准确的理解。它是感知最锐利的一端，此时地图显露出自身的结构。

normalIntro.en: Real pieces only: per- 'thoroughly', capere 'take', perceptio, the sensation/perception split in 19th-century psychology, and the specere/centum traps.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：per-“彻底”、capere“拿取”、perceptio、19 世纪心理学对感觉与知觉的划分，以及 specere 与 centum 两个陷阱。

normal.en: Per- is 'thoroughly' and capere is 'take': perception is the senses taking the world in completely enough to hold it.
normal.cn: per- 是“彻底”，capere 是“拿取”：perception 就是感官把世界拿进来，拿得足够完整以便握住。

normal.en: Cavere and capture share the same capere family; perception is capture without a fight, the world seized by the eye.
normal.cn: cavere 与 capture 同属 capere 词族；perception 是一场没有搏斗的俘获，世界被眼睛抓走。

normal.en: The percept is what is taken in; the perception is the taking; perceptive is the person who takes quickly.
normal.cn: percept 是被拿进来的东西；perception 是拿的行为；perceptive 是拿得快的人。

normal.en: Perspective looks from a place, perception takes something in: the first is about the eye's position, the second about the mind's grasp.
normal.cn: perspective 从某处看出去，perception 把东西拿进来：前者关于眼睛的位置，后者关于头脑的把握。

normal.en: Percentage shares the per- but not the root: centum is 'hundred', so a percentage is a count, not a grasp.
normal.cn: percentage 共享 per- 却不共享词根：centum 是“一百”，所以百分比是计数，不是把握。

abstract.en: The eye is a net; the world is a sea. What you call reality is the catch you happened to bring up.
abstract.cn: 眼睛是一张网，世界是一片海。你称为现实的东西，只是你碰巧捞上来的那一网。

abstract.en: Two people stand in the same rain; one hears noise, one hears the storm weakening. The rain did not change.
abstract.cn: 两个人站在同一场雨里；一个听见噪音，一个听见暴风雨在减弱。雨并没有变。

abstract.en: A public image is a map drawn by strangers, and you cannot revise it with a pen you do not hold.
abstract.cn: 公众形象是陌生人画的地图，你手里没有那支笔，就改不动它。

examples.en: Depth perception depends on having two eyes that work together.
examples.cn: 深度知觉依赖于两只眼睛协同工作。

examples.en: The campaign tried to change public perception of the tax.
examples.cn: 这场宣传活动试图改变公众对这项税收的看法。

examples.en: Her perception of the room's mood was immediate and accurate.
examples.cn: 她对房间气氛的感知既迅速又准确。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破塞普申」——眼睛像一只手“破”开外面的世界，把看到的东西“塞”进脑子里 → perception 知觉；看法；洞察力（只借音，不表词源）

root: 拉丁 percipere「拿进来、把握、感知」，由 per-「彻底」+ capere「拿取」构成，动作名词为 perceptio。核心是「感官把外面的世界彻底拿进来，在内里画成一张地图」。同族含 perceive、percept、perceptive、perceptual、perceptible；perspective（specere「看」）与 percentage（centum「一百」）只是形近，词根不同。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of perception all describe a hand taking the world in and drawing a map inside. What changes is what is taken (sensory data, meaning, public opinion), how sharp the hand is, or whether we are naming the act, the field, or the machine that now does the taking.
sensesIntro.cn: perception 的九个义项都描述一只手把世界拿进来、在内里画成地图。变化的是拿进来的东西（感官材料、意义、公众意见）、这只手有多敏锐，以及我们命名的是行为、学科，还是如今承担这件事的机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes and ears take the outer world in and draw an inner map with names written on it.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛和耳朵把外面的世界收进一张内部地图，并在上面写下名字。

branches.en: TAKING IN: sensory awareness and the acuity of the instrument that does the taking.
branches.cn: 拿进来：感官觉察，以及执行拿取的那件仪器的敏锐度。

branches.en: READING THE MAP: mental understanding of a situation, and insight into what the map hides.
branches.cn: 读地图：对情境的心智理解，以及看穿地图所藏之物的洞察力。

branches.en: SHARED MAPS: the view a public holds, and the impression one person creates in another's head.
branches.cn: 共享的地图：公众持有的看法，以及一个人在他人头脑中造成的印象。

branches.en: THE STUDY OF THE MAP: experimental psychology of perception, and the philosophical question of whether the map matches the land.
branches.cn: 对地图的研究：实验心理学中的知觉研究，以及地图是否与真实地形相符的哲学问题。

branches.en: THE SILICON EYE: a machine takes in signals and names what it finds.
branches.cn: 硅做的眼睛：机器接收信号并命名它所发现的东西。

intro.en: Perception is percept- plus -ion (Latin -ionem). Percept- comes from Latin percipere, per- 'thoroughly' + capere 'take'. The family splits neatly: -ion the act, -ive the person, -ual the property, -ible the possibility, and percept the object.
intro.cn: perception 是 percept- 加 -ion（拉丁 -ionem）。percept- 出自拉丁 percipere，即 per-“彻底”+ capere“拿取”。词族分工整齐：-ion 行为、-ive 人、-ual 属性、-ible 可能性，percept 则是对象。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is capere 'take', percipere 'take in thoroughly', perceptio 'a taking in', and perceptum 'the thing taken in'. The same capere with other prefixes gives receive, accept, intercept, and participate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层是 capere“拿取”、percipere“彻底拿进来”、perceptio“拿进来这件事”、perceptum“被拿进来之物”。同一个 capere 配上其他前缀，还产生表示“接收”“接受”“拦截”与“参与”的词。

items.meaning: the act or result of taking in through the senses or mind
items.meaningCN: 通过感官或心智拿进来的行为或结果（-ion 动作名词）
items.example: Perception of the signal dropped in the fog.
items.exampleCN: 雾中对该信号的感知减弱了。

items.meaning: to become aware of, to take in
items.meaningCN: 察觉；把……收入感知（per- 彻底 + capere 拿取）
items.example: They perceived a change in his tone.
items.exampleCN: 他们察觉到他的语气变了。

items.structure: Latin perceptum, neuter past participle of percipere
items.meaning: the object or content of a perception
items.example: The percept is the red patch, not the apple itself.
items.exampleCN: 知觉对象是那块红色，而不是苹果本身。

items.meaningCN: 察觉与理解敏捷的；有洞察力的（-ive 倾向形容词）
items.example: A perceptive reader notices the repeated image.
items.exampleCN: 有洞察力的读者会注意到反复出现的意象。

items.meaning: relating to perception as a process
items.meaningCN: 与知觉过程有关的（-ual 形容词）
items.exampleCN: 知觉学习会随练习而提高。

items.example: There was a perceptible drop in temperature.

items.meaningCN: 太轻微而察觉不到的（im- 否定）
items.example: The change was imperceptible at first.
items.exampleCN: 起初这一变化察觉不到。

items.meaningCN: 错误的知觉或印象（mis- 错误）
items.exampleCN: 这个错误印象持续了好多年。

items.meaning: a point of view; the art of showing depth
items.meaningCN: 观点；透视法（per- + specere 看 + -ive）

latinEntries.meaning: that which has been taken in
